perception_driver: 1. 高空自然景观视觉美感 (Aerial Visual Scenery & Aesthetics)
psychological_mechanism: 视觉感官冲击 override 生理/心理焦虑（震撼美感弥散覆盖恐惧）
key_perceptual_terms: view, scenery, spectacular, breathtaking, majestic, surreal, canyon, glacier

perception_driver: 2. 飞行员专业技术与安全抚慰 (Pilot Competence & Empathetic Reassurance)
psychological_mechanism: 飞行员高超平稳技术与幽默安抚建立信任锚点（信任化解恐惧）
key_perceptual_terms: pilot, captain, professional, calm, reassuring, smooth, informative, safe

perception_driver: 3. 飞行体感平稳与机舱环境 (Aircraft Riding Smoothness & Cabin Comfort)
psychological_mechanism: 气流平稳度与通风耳机设备缓解幽闭/晕机躯体反应（躯体舒缓化解不适）
key_perceptual_terms: smooth, air flow, comfortable, headsets, clear windows, gentle ride

perception_driver: 4. 地勤前置服务与热情接待 (Ground Staff Hospitality & Pre-Flight Care)
psychological_mechanism: 登机前贴心关怀与迅速检录降低前置期待焦虑（热情接待建立正面基调）
key_perceptual_terms: staff, ground, welcome, check-in, friendly, helpful, snacks, drinks
